# Android — 14 policies

All policies are named `CXNM - Standard - AND - <D|U> - <Item>`; the tables below show the `<Item>` part.

| Folder | Count |
|---|---:|
| `CompliancePolicies/` | 8 |
| `DeviceConfigurations/` | 2 |
| `AppProtection/` | 1 |
| `SettingsCatalog/` | 3 |

## Device-scoped (D) — 2

Assign to device groups.

| Policy | What it does | Type | Settings | Assignment |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| [**Compliance Dedicated Device Health**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_AND_D_Compliance_Dedicated_Device_Health.en.md) | Marks a dedicated Android device (kiosk or shared) as non-compliant when it is rooted, Play Integrity does not pass with hardware backing, the Intune app has been tampered with, storage is not encrypted or the latest security patch is older than the minimum. | Compliance | — | — |
| [**System Updates**](DeviceConfigurations/Baseline_AND_D_System_Updates.en.md) | Installs Android system updates on organisation-owned devices automatically in a maintenance window between 00:00 and 06:00. | Device config | — | — |

## User-scoped (U) — 12

Assign to user groups.

| Policy | What it does | Type | Settings | Assignment |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| [**App Protection**](AppProtection/Baseline_AND_U_App_Protection.en.md) | Protects corporate data within the Microsoft apps on a personal Android phone: separate PIN, encryption, no copying to personal apps, and remote wipe of only the work data. | App Protection | — | All Users |
| [**Compliance Block Device Administrator**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_AND_U_Compliance_Block_Device_Administrator.en.md) | Marks every Android device still managed with the legacy device administrator as non-compliant, so that it has to move to Android Enterprise. | Compliance | — | — |
| [**Compliance Corporate Defender for Endpoint**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_AND_U_Compliance_Corporate_Defender_for_Endpoint.en.md) | Marks a fully managed or corporate-owned Android device as non-compliant when Defender for Endpoint gives it a risk score higher than low. | Compliance | — | — |
| [**Compliance Corporate Device Health**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_AND_U_Compliance_Corporate_Device_Health.en.md) | Marks a fully managed or corporate-owned Android device as non-compliant when it is rooted, Play Integrity does not pass with hardware backing, the Intune app has been tampered with, it runs below Android 16 or the latest security patch is older than the minimum. | Compliance | — | — |
| [**Compliance Corporate Password**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_AND_U_Compliance_Corporate_Password.en.md) | Checks whether a fully managed or corporate-owned Android device has a numeric complex code of at least six digits, locks after fifteen minutes, does not reuse the last five codes and is encrypted. | Compliance | — | — |
| [**Compliance Defender for Endpoint**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_AND_U_Compliance_Defender_for_Endpoint.en.md) | Marks an Android device with a personal work profile as non-compliant when Defender for Endpoint gives it a risk score higher than low. | Compliance | — | — |
| [**Compliance Device Health**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_AND_U_Compliance_Device_Health.en.md) | Marks an Android device with a personal work profile as non-compliant when it is rooted, USB debugging is enabled, apps from outside the Play Store are allowed, Play Integrity cannot be confirmed with hardware backing, or the latest security patch is older than the minimum. | Compliance | — | — |
| [**Compliance Password**](CompliancePolicies/Baseline_AND_U_Compliance_Password.en.md) | Checks whether an Android device with a personal work profile has a screen lock of medium complexity, whether the work profile additionally requires its own code of at least six digits (numeric complex, medium complexity) that locks after fifteen minutes, and whether storage is encrypted. | Compliance | — | — |
| [**Corporate AI Restricted**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_AND_U_Corporate_AI_Restricted.en.md) | Prevents screen content from being sent to an assistant app (such as Gemini or Circle to Search) on fully managed and corporate-owned Android devices, and prevents apps from exposing functions to AI agents. | Settings Catalog | 2 | — |
| [**Corporate Data Protection**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_AND_U_Corporate_Data_Protection.en.md) | Blocks screenshots, file sharing via Bluetooth and factory reset by the user on fully managed and corporate-owned Android devices. | Settings Catalog | 3 | — |
| [**Corporate Device Security**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_AND_U_Corporate_Device_Security.en.md) | Hardens fully managed and corporate-owned Android devices: six-digit code (numeric complex) that wipes after ten attempts, the code once a day instead of biometrics only, screen on for at most fifteen minutes, Play Protect and automatic app updates on, no file transfer via USB or external storage, no 2G, no manual time, no Private Space and no sharing from work to personal. | Settings Catalog | 14 | — |
| [**Work Profile Restrictions**](DeviceConfigurations/Baseline_AND_U_Work_Profile_Restrictions.en.md) | On a device with a personal work profile, sets a separate work profile code (six digits, medium complexity, locks after fifteen minutes, wipes only the work profile after ten attempts), blocks copying, sharing and screenshots from work to personal, and turns on Play Protect. | Device config | — | — |

---

**What it does** comes from `doel` in [`_manifest.json`](../_manifest.json) (translated). The same
sentence sits, together with the assignment target and the origin, in the template's `Description`
field — and so later in the tenant next to the policy.
